title: Rune Damage Cap
problem: A hit above 10% is cut to 5%; 5–10% goes through.
notes: In-game test:  Fix: S 2026-10-26 (user: decide from code, no test): text 'False God can't take more damage than 5% of Health'; threshold fixed 0.1 -> 0.05.

release_notes.intended: A False God can't take more damage than 5% of its Health from a hit.
release_notes.actual: In the unpatched game, hits of 5% to 10% went through uncapped; only bigger hits were cut.
release_notes.fix: Now every hit is capped at 5% of Health.
